item.title: Show HN: Secure dev boxes for your Mac (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN, I don't want to run node.js on my Mac directly anymore, so I've built MyBox. Maybe you find it useful too: MyBox is built on a fork of apple/container. * Each box has its own Linux kernel. * No mounts: Project files get copied. * Packet filtering: No access to Mac and local network. * Dedicated user: Apps cannot reach into the box. * Touch ID/password: To open a shell or copy files. https://github.com/janpmz/mybox Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50438688 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Tell HN: Made my first sale as a first time founder (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hey folks I'm really happy today, I made my first sale of the product I have been building at veludocs.com . I had quit my job a year and half ago, and have been dabbling with several ideas and locked in with this product. I have been a long time lurker at this forum. I come from a family background that has "salary man" attitude, and risk taking is unheard of. I do not know if this would take off, but the feeling that a stranger chose to pay for what I built for is out of the world. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50438610 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
